note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for packs/ash-pplan-protocol-court-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"actions" emits one row per action (a param is a required conjunct), VALUES on
pcp:param -- the action-level required facts (rdfs:label, pcp:order, pcp:effect) are
"statuses" is anchored on pcp:terminal (required conjunct), NOT rdfs:label -- label
is shared vocabulary across State/Transition/Action/Guard/Property classes here.
"mutants" is anchored on pcp:guardDrop, carried by pcp:Mutant rows only.
